description: This file defines the StrLength class, which is a validation rule used to ensure that the length of a string falls within specified minimum and maximum bounds. The class supports configurable inclusive/exclusive bounds and handles multibyte encodings. It is part of a validation framework in the OrangeHRM core API module.

classes.name: StrLength
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a string's length is within specified bounds, supporting multibyte encoding and inclusive/exclusive bounds.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the StrLength validator with optional min/max bounds, encoding, and inclusive flag. Validates that max is not less than min.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input string has a length within the specified bounds using the helper trait for string length measurement.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Checks if the string length meets the minimum bound, considering whether bounds are inclusive.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Checks if the string length does not exceed the maximum bound, considering whether bounds are inclusive.
